description: Transform your project management reporting with the P6-Gantt Chart Visual — a professional Power BI custom visual that brings Oracle Primavera P6-style scheduling directly to your dashboards. 5 PROFESSIONAL LAYOUTS Switch instantly between layouts using the in-visual dropdown: P6 Layout — Primavera P6-style resizable columns, activity bars, WBS hierarchy Classic — Standard Gantt with baselines, variance, and dependency lines Dependencies — Critical path colour-coded bars with FS/SS/FF/SF arrows Float Analysis — 6-band float color system with activity distribution histogram Dashboard — Executive KPI overview with traffic-light schedule health indicators KEY FEATURES Unlimited WBS hierarchy with expand/collapse (state persists across pages) P6-style bar colors: blue (completed) · green (remaining) · red (critical) Baseline bars and schedule variance analysis Dependency arrows parsed automatically from Predecessor IDs Data date line, today line, and custom time frame filter Resizable columns and table/Gantt split divider in P6 layout Diamond milestones exactly as in Primavera P6 Rich hover tooltips on Gantt bars; activity name on row hover All KPIs and float histograms reflect the full project, not just expanded rows Full font, color, and column visibility controls per layout in the Format pane
